_doc: mapsee_ingest_lcsd.py - Hong Kong's Leisure and Cultural Services Department: SmartPlay's WALK-IN community sports sessions (no enrolment, FEE 0) and the cultural programme at LCSD's town halls, civic centres, theatres and museums. DATA.GOV.HK terms: free re-use with attribution. Read the adapter's header before changing a filter: every refusal is counted in the run's output.
_bbox: S, W, N, E: the SAR with Lantau and the outlying islands. A point outside is a parse gone wrong (Sham Shui Po Sports Centre's published longitude is 144-14-90).
_district_check: A facility point (or a geocoded one) is refused when strictly more of its district's other facilities lie beyond district_check_km than within it. 6 of 141 facility points failed on 2026-10-05, all wrong by eye; Islands district spans Lantau to Cheung Chau, so it gets its own radius.
_geocode_check_km: A geocoded point must be this close to the nearest facility of its district (district_radius_km overrides). 2026-10-05: right answers within 2.5 km, Photon's wrong parks 3.7 and 4.9 km.
attribution: Source: Leisure and Cultural Services Department, HKSAR (DATA.GOV.HK, free re-use with attribution).
_venue_aliases: SmartPlay's EN_VENUE spelling -> the facility list's Name_en, both after venue_key() (lower case, parentheticals gone, & -> and). Only names measured to differ.

venue_aliases.jc tuen mun butterfly beach sports centr: the jockey club tuen mun butterfly beach sports centre

_sources_order: The cultural programme is read first: 4 requests and about 6 geocodes, so a slow SmartPlay transfer or a cold geocode cache (310 s, 35 venues left for the next run, measured 2026-10-05) can never use up --max-minutes before it.

sources.name: LCSD cultural programmes
sources._venue_include: null keeps every LCSD venue. A regex here (e.g. 'Town Hall|Civic Centre') would keep the district halls only; see the adapter header for the numbers behind keeping all.
sources._category_by_cat2: LCSD's cat2 codes, named from the titles they carry (2026-10-03/05): sc1 orchestral and choral concerts, sc2 Cantonese opera, sc3 dance, sc4 exhibitions, sc5 film, sc6 drama and musicals, sc7 multi-arts, sc8 community concerts, sc9 pop, sc10 festivals, sc12 variety shows, sc14 hirers' programmes, inc7 health talks and exhibitions, inc9 carnivals and community arts.

sources.name: LCSD SmartPlay walk-in programmes
sources._category_by_title: First match wins, read on the folded English title; then category_by_type on EN_ACT_TYPE_NAME; then category_default.
